about: Hidden PRO fights per main map and side map (package PRO, owner 2026-10-24 00:28; PRO2 21:20; PRO3 2026-10-25: side maps as N-L-PRO-k, faction cards left out). N-PRO-k: the best decks of the deck optimizer's map-true runs (the map's own cards + what a player holds by then, within the map's rarity cap); N-BPRO-k (Basic Pro, under `bpro`): its bpro runs (only the map's own pool, within the cap). Written by tools/opt/pro_skirmishes.js --apply; baked into the game by assemble_arena.py (the `pro` list; `bpro` waits for the PRO preview package). Not on the road, no progress, no rewards.
